spans.s:
mn. (-हः-हं)
1 Iron, either crude or wrought.
2

Steel.
3

Any metal.
4 A weapon.
5 Aloe wood or

Agallochum.
6

Blood.
m. (-हः)
A red-coloured goat.
E.
ल to cut, aff. ह.

m. (-कः)
A thorny shrub.
E.
लोह iron, and कण्टक a thorn.

n. (-न्तं)
The loadstone.
E.
लोह iron, and कान्त in this compound a gem.

m. (-रः)
A blacksmith, an ironsmith.
E.
लोह iron, and कार who works in; also with कन् added लोहकारक m. (-कः)

n. (-ट्टं)
Rust of iron, or iron filings.
E.
लोह, and किट्ट soil or sediment.

n. (-र्णं)
Iron filings.
E.
लोह, and चूर्ण powder.

n. (-जं)
1 Bell-metal.
2 Rust of iron, or iron filings.
E.
लोह iron, and ज produced.

m. (-जित्)
The diamond.
E.
लोह iron, and जित् conquering, (in hardness.)

n. (-कं)
A hell.
E.
लोह, and दारक what tears.

m. (-वी)
Borax.
E.
लोह metal, and द्राविन् what fuses.

m. (-लः)
An iron arrow.
E.
लोह iron, and नाल a stalk.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A heron.
E.
लोह iron, and पृष्ठ the back.

f. (-मा)
1 An image of iron.
2 An anvil.
E.
लोह iron, and प्रतिमा an image.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of iron.
E.
लोह iron, aff. मयट्.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)
E.
लोह iron, and मारक destroying.

n. (-कं)
Silver.
E.
लोह metal, राज shining, कन् added.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Lisping, speaking inarticulately.
2 Iron, irony.
m. (-लः)
The principal ring of a chain.
E.
लोह iron, ला to get or be, aff. क.

n. (-रं)
Gold.
E.
लोह a metal, and वर best.

n. (-र्म्म)
Mail, iron armour.
E.
लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
1 A hell.
2 An iron pike.
E.
लोह, and शङ्कु a pike.

m. (-णः)
Borax.
E.
लोह metal, श्चिष to embrace, to lay hold of, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
Lustration of arms, ceremonies performed on the ninth of the light half of the month Aśvin; formerly a celebration observed by princes before opening a campaign, but now usually confined to the domestic decoration and worship of the soldier's weapons.
E.
लोह a weapon, अभि about, सृ to go, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिहार.

m. (-रः)
Lustration of arms.
E.
लोह a weapon, अभि about, हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिसार.

n. (-षं)
The flesh of a goat with red hair.
E.
लोह, and आमिष flesh.

f. (-का)
A sort of large shallow bowl, sometimes of iron, but usually of wood and bound with iron, for the purpose of washing rice, &c.
E.
लोह iron, कन् aff. fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता or ती-तं)
Red, of a red colour.
m. (-तः)
1 Red, the colour.
2 The planet

MARS.
3

One of the male rivers.
4 The Rohi, a kind of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.)
5 A sort of deer.
6 A snake.
7 A deity, a demi-god.
8 A sort of bean, (Ervum hirsutum.)
9 A form of array.
10 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.)
n. (-तं)
1

Blood.
2
A red kind of

Agallochum.
3

Saffron.
4

Red sanders.
5 War, battle.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman red with anger or with colour, &c.
2 A sort of creeper, (Lycopodium imbricatum.)
E.
रुह to grow, इतन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed to ल.

mfn. (-कः-तिका or -णिका-कं)
Red.
m. (-कः)
1 A ruby.
2 The planet MARS.
n. (-कं)
Calx of brass.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-नं)
Saffron.
E.
लोहित red, and चन्दन Sandal.

f. (-का)
Red chalk.
E.
लोहित red, and मृत्तिका soil, earth.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
लोहित red, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The planet MARS.
E.
लोहित red, and अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Red-faced.
m. (-नः)
An ichneumon.
E.
लोहित red, and आनन the face.

n. (-यः)
Copper.
E.
लोहित red, and अयस् iron.

f. (-णी)
A woman red with anger, or painted red.
E.
see रोहित, the fem. aff. being ङीप्, and the penultimate consonant changed to न.

n. (-मं)
Gold.
E.
लोह a metal, and उत्तस best.
